name: Smart inbox: only what needs you
author: wizard
description: Chats › Inbox holds what needs you or answers you: a needs-you, a check-this ask (green, not amber), an approval, a failed run (with one line saying why), every finished answer to something you typed or said (no keyword guess), plus deliveries you set up (scheduled runs, reminders, the Daily brief, a thread you pinned like Topics). Sent keeps the rest: running chats (Sent › Working), answers to a reply-button tap or a plain thanks / ok, a reminder just set, [SILENT] runs, and watches and helper results you didn't start. Unread alone never puts a chat in Inbox, and a chat is never in both. Typed tasks go quiet too once Wizard has guessed them right often enough (90% of 50): a typed new chat that is a plain task, with no reply, question or "let me know when", runs in the background like an orb dump and waits in Sent › Working; Sent shows how often the guess was right.
